plugins.title: Yaps Dictation
plugins.description: Check voice typing readiness and recover recent dictations with local Yaps. Uses your existing dictation models and desktop shortcuts.

plugins.title: Yaps Transcription
plugins.description: Transcribe local audio and video files into plain text with Yaps. Private speech-to-text for podcasts, interviews, recordings, and voice memos.

plugins.title: Yaps Meeting Notes
plugins.description: Turn recordings into speaker-labelled meeting notes, recaps, chapters, and grounded answers with the local Yaps engine.

plugins.title: Yaps Text to Speech
plugins.description: Read text aloud and create local WAV narration with Yaps voices. Text-to-speech for scripts, documents, and voice-overs.

plugins.title: Yaps Background Removal
plugins.description: Remove image backgrounds locally with Yaps. Export transparent PNG cutouts or place the subject on a solid colour while preserving your source image.

plugins.title: Yaps Audio Cleaner
plugins.description: Reduce noise, hiss, and static in speech recordings with local Yaps Audio Cleaner. Export a separate cleaned WAV for podcasts, interviews, and voice notes.

plugins.title: Yaps Auto Captions
plugins.description: Add styled captions and word highlighting to local videos with Yaps. Review editable captions and export a separate captioned MP4.

plugins.title: Yaps SRT Generator
plugins.description: Generate timestamped SRT subtitle files from local audio or video with Yaps. Create separate subtitles without changing the source recording.

plugins.title: Yaps Translation
plugins.description: Translate text, Markdown, and SRT subtitles privately with local Yaps translation models. Preserve subtitle timing and create separate translated files.

plugins.title: Yaps Video to Audio
plugins.description: Extract a video's soundtrack to MP3, WAV, or M4A with Yaps. Fast local audio conversion that preserves the original video.

plugins.title: Yaps Auto Cut
plugins.description: Remove dead air and long pauses from local videos with Yaps Auto Cut. Review and tune the cut plan, then export a separate tightened MP4.

plugins.title: Yaps Memory
plugins.description: Search, cite, and maintain your private local Yaps Markdown vault across tasks. Scoped memory and requested note edits with Yaps Agent Access controls.
